// Em dashes (U+2014) inside text strings (14 or more characters). 5 in this file.
export const COUNT = [
  'Wait\u2014what happened here?', // 1: written as an escape
  'A pause \u2014 then another \u2014 then silence.', // 2
  'Raw dash — inside the text.', // 1: the character itself
  `${a} \u2014 ${b} and more text`, // 1
]

// None of these count.
export const NO_COUNT = [
  '\u2014', // a text string needs 14 characters
  'no dash here at all, just text',
  'En dash \u2013 is a different mark.', // U+2013 is not U+2014
]
